To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) rats maintained on a chronic all-liquid ethanol diet for 6 weeks displayed a variety of behavioral disturbances during withdrawal; 2) these disturbances persisted for at least 3 days after the cessation of ethanol; 3) these behavioral manifestations were not observed in rats maintained on the same diet without ethanol; and 4) these behaviors can be used to quantitate withdrawal severity in rats.
